subject: math
description: Identify the axes, origin, quadrants, and ordered pairs on the coordinate plane, then plot and name points accurately.
learningObjectives: Identify the x-axis, y-axis, and origin on a coordinate plane
Read ordered pairs in the form (x, y)
Use coordinate signs to name the correct quadrant
Plot points from ordered pairs accurately
Name plotted points using ordered pairs
prerequisites: Reading values on a number line
